hitl_conditions: No explicit conditions stated; manual operation is displaced where automatic assembly stations and automatic material distribution are introduced to raise efficiency and quality conformance, while humans keep visual monitoring, upstream process-plan approval and dispatching.
key_finding: A three-layer (hardware/software/application) digital-twin assembly platform for aerospace mixed-line production couples a workshop-level twin (plan, logistics and quality optimization via data mining) with a line-level twin (fuzzy-reasoning model matching driving equipment monitoring, path and inventory optimization); optimized information is fed back automatically to the shop floor.

quotes.text: The ERP system releases production orders. Dispatchers and operators prepare for production according to production tasks. The assembly process integration management and control software system receives the production orders and assembly process planning scheme.
